mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which may stimulate economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the 20-day windows following low FEDFUNDS levels.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate suggests economic weakness, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the 20-day windows following an unemployment rate increase.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in GDP growth indicates reduced economic activity, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 60% of the 60-day windows following a GDP growth slowdown.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production suggests reduced economic output, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the 20-day windows following an industrial production decline.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment combined with a rise in unemployment rate indicates potential labor market inefficiencies, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 40% of the 60-day windows following simultaneous increases in PAYEMS and UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in housing starts indicates reduced consumer demand, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 50% of the 20-day windows following a slowdown in housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in federal funds rate combined with high inflation indicates tighter monetary conditions, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 40% of the 20-day windows following increases in both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 30% of the 60-day windows following payroll employment increases.
